reaction: Closing the door. It ends here, a bit sudden.
The ending named the thing I did: read the page aloud and nobody addressed it. That was fair. But it was over in a minute.
The game ended after about a minute. I saw the loop: two buttons a screen, no words of my own.
Stopping the phone. It finished fast, the ending named what I did, but I only ever picked between two set buttons and the story was over before I felt like I made it mine.
